children: CSL ENTERS AGREEMENTS WITH THE U.S. GOVERNMENT TO LOWER DRUG PRICES  AND SUPPORT INVESTMENT IN U.S. MANUFACTURING
CSL LTD: AGREEMENTS SUPPORT LOWER PRICES FOR CSL THERAPIES AND REFLECT CSL'S $1.5 BILLION PLAN TO EXPAND ITS  U.S. MANUFACTURING CAPACITY IN ILLINOIS
CSL : ENTERED INTO ONSHORING AGREEMENT WITH THE U.S. DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE
CSL LTD: PROJECT IS EXPECTED TO CREATE AT LEAST 300 NEW PHARMACEUTICAL MANUFACTURING  JOBS AND APPROXIMATELY 800 CONSTRUCTION AND RELATED JOBS
CSL : DOES NOT ANTICIPATE ANY MATERIAL IMPACT DURING FISCAL YEAR 2027
CSL : AGREEMENTS PROVIDE CSL WITH ADDITIONAL CERTAINTY REGARDING EXPOSURE TO U.S. DRUG PRICING & CERTAIN SECTION 232 TARIFFS
CSL : PROJECT TO SUBSTANTIALLY INCREASE CO'S ABILITY TO PRODUCE IMMUNOGLOBULINS & ALBUMIN FOR PEOPLE WITH RARE DISEASES & SERIOUS CONDITIONS
